title: Minnesota Statutes, Chapter 356 - Retirement Systems, Generally
verified_how: Fetched https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/356 (HTTP 200): '2025 Minnesota Statutes', topic 'RETIREMENT', 'CHAPTER 356. RETIREMENT SYSTEMS, GENERALLY', with a notice that 356.001 subd. 3, 356.20 subd. 2, 356.214 subd. 1 and 356.215 subd. 8 were amended in the 2026 Regular Session (ch. 56 s. 29; ch. 106 art. 5 ss. 36-38).
notes: Cross-cutting chapter governing all Minnesota public pension plans; the individual plan statutes are chs. 352 (state employees), 353 (PERA) and 354 (teachers). Old-age, survivors and disability insurance itself is federal (42 U.S.C. ch. 7).
